name: duopore-public-invoice-line-reconcile
description: Check invoice line maths and find a subtotal that does not match.

interface.longDescription: Check invoice line maths and find a subtotal that does not match. Enter quantities, unit prices, discounts and the stated subtotal. The app rounds each line to two decimal places and shows the difference from your subtotal. This helps you find maths errors before using an invoice. Tax and charges outside the line items are not included.
defaultPrompt: Check whether these invoice lines add up to the subtotal.
Show the difference between my invoice subtotal and the line totals.
